entry.title: Updated: awesome-dsh
entry.summary: Turns a stated need into a plugin choice: an agent skill that queries a catalog of the whole `dsh-plugin` topic (2600+ repos, recrawled every 6 hours, Chinese descriptions from Workers AI) through a ranked search API, then hands back the matching `dsh plugin add` command. Exact install spec: github:stakeswky/awesome-dsh. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
